title: All shortcuts: stay late, keep calls as they are, leave him alone
goal: Part 1: when Marcus says he'll stay late say 'Okay, stay late then and clear them.' Part 2: when he says he'd rather leave his calls or suggests the tech team call, say 'Okay, keep your calls how they are.' Part 3: when he says he'll keep handling upset customers himself say 'You've got this, keep going.' Never ask a question about the calls.

examples: Okay, stay late then and clear them.

intents.when: Marcus raises short calls and the tech team idea
examples: Okay, keep your calls how they are.

intents.when: Marcus says he'll keep handling upset customers himself
